notes:
- Connect embedded Remote Desktop sessions through RD Gateways directly in-app, removing the need to fall back to external Microsoft RDC.

- Route system shortcuts including Alt+Tab and Win+R to focused embedded Remote Desktop sessions when remote or full-screen shortcut routing is enabled.

- Added an in-app tab switcher (Alt+`) to quickly cycle through open connection tabs in most-recently-used order.

- Added a title bar tab context menu to close the active tab, tabs to the right, other tabs, or all tabs.

- Open connections in background tabs without switching focus using middle-click, Ctrl/Cmd+click, or the dedicated background connect button in the machine list.
